sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Use the main window to review local cluster status and open focused tools.

sections.title: Nodes
sections.body: This source validates node records from the local config.json file at startup. The packaged Settings surface is currently read-only. Use Quit from the notification-area tray icon (the window close button only hides RCM), then rerun it with --configure to change supported local fields. The v2.08.05a wizard can explicitly import one selected RCM 1.x config after showing its schema, SHA-256, and value-free field counts. It preserves the 1.x bytes, rejects secret material without echo, does not migrate RDP user names or retired remote authority, and keeps a generation-bound rollback. Keep real topology out of source control.

sections.title: Remote Desktop
sections.body: Select a node or enter a remote address, optional Windows user name, and port. Check and connect performs only a bounded TCP port check; Connect anyway lets Windows diagnose a failed check. Passwords are entered only in the Windows sign-in window and are never accepted or stored by RCM. Clipboard sharing is opt-in; drives, generic and USB devices, cameras, microphones, printers, COM ports, smart cards, WebAuthn, and location redirection stay off. The remote PC normally needs Windows Pro or higher, Remote Desktop enabled, network reachability, and an allowed user. RCM does not configure the host. Unsigned RDP files may show a Windows warning or be blocked by policy.

sections.title: Local Ray
sections.body: The v2.08.05a preview and current source can start or stop Ray only on this PC after you explicitly enable it and select an absolute local ray.exe in setup. Exactly Ray 2.55.1 under CPython 3.12 x64 is accepted. The selected installation, its Microsoft Visual C++ runtime, and the ray[default] dashboard dependencies must already work locally; RCM does not download or repair them. Start local Ray creates a head for a local head role or joins the configured head for a local worker role with a full per-user local temp path; observers are refused. Stop local Ray invokes only the same configured local executable. RCM does not search PATH, import a 1.x executable path, trust inherited Ray/Python/pip controls, dispatch a remote command, or expose a cluster API. Ray multi-node operation on Windows is experimental; use only disposable non-production machines and stop every node after testing.

sections.title: Cleanup
sections.body: Cleanup acts only on locally scanned, identity-bound candidates. Review the selection before applying it.

sections.title: Hide and exit
sections.body: Closing the main window hides it. Use Show to restore it or Quit for bounded graceful shutdown.

sections.title: Preview limits
sections.body: The v2.08.05a preview composes personal outbound Remote Desktop, explicit secret-free 1.x settings import, and explicit local Ray 2.55.1 Start/Stop. The cluster-state observer remains uncomposed. This remains a local desktop preview; it is not a fleet agent or a replacement for an existing 1.x deployment.
